info.title: Kadé gateway-merchant
info.description: Backend-for-frontend for the restaurant app (apps/restaurant). Money is whole rupees (LKR). Errors are application/problem+json with a stable `code`. Mutations accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. Realtime: WebSocket /ws (see the gateway README). Every staff route acts for the caller's outlet (x-outlet-id), resolved from the token or merchant's GetMyOutlets.
